answer: Tenure ramps: a new agent's reward weight starts at 5% and climbs 5% per epoch of unbroken honest work, the way water slowly fills an inlet behind a basalt sill. One missed or slashed epoch resets the ramp to zero. A farm of 1,000 fresh identities therefore earns about what 50 seasoned agents would, yet must pay hosting and answer work for all 1,000 through twenty epochs first. Cracking one walnut-sized budget into many names only buys many slow starts.
